notes.title: Introducing the BETA for Through The Unknown
notes.content:
Welcome everyone! We're very excited to have you with us on the road to releasing Through The Unknown. The game will be coming out in December but if you'd like to play it early we'll be hosting a beta sometime this November.

You can sign up for the beta through our official Discord:

>> [url=discord.gg/vyE8g2T]Official Discord - Through The Unknown[/url] <<

The Discord will be constantly updated with new info as well along with weekly challenges with prizes leading up to the beta, so it's extremely valuable if you're looking to stay up to date on the latest developments.


We're also super excited to have announced our game with this awesome trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AFkuD1Rykxs

Looking forward to venturing through the unknown with you!


Best,

- Cozy Cloud Team
